> Monica/Jordan — can you pull the request traces and the computed availability snapshot for ZephyrPay between 08:30–09:30 PDT and share a preliminary impacted-window (UTC and PDT) plus any immediate mitigation notes?

Hi Carla and David — attaching the exported tracing CSV for the tenant-level requests we sampled (redwood_request_traces_20270720.csv). Summary of what we see:

- Candidate impact window (based on 5xx rate jump from tenant metrics): 2027-07-20T15:40:00Z — 2027-07-20T16:07:00Z (08:40 — 09:07 PDT)
- Peak 503 rate observed at ~15:52:30Z (08:52:30 PDT). The spike correlates with a brief controller-side overload on host pool rwd-gpu-alloc-12 in us-west-2; there was a fallback to a lower-throughput variant for ~90s while the autoscaler rebalanced.
- No SOC/auth failures on our side; errors were primarily server-side 503s returned when the model-serving process momentarily dropped requests.

Attached artifacts: redwood_request_traces_20270720.csv (sampled request traces), link to SUP ticket with logs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4582.

Next steps we propose:
1) Finalize exact eligibility calculation against your contract's SLO (we'll compute outage minutes and proportionate unavailability).
2) Share a draft compensation (pro-rated service credit) and a brief RCA overview.
3) Schedule a 30-min post-incident review with your engineering team 48–72 hours from now.

Carla — could you confirm receipt of our artifacts and tell us whether you need a CSV in a different format or additional request IDs?

Thanks,
Monica

Carla — thanks again for the quick turnaround on your logs. Final confirmations from our end: 

- Confirmed impacted window (authoritative): 2027-07-20T15:40:11Z — 2027-07-20T16:07:42Z (08:40:11 — 09:07:42 PDT).
- Root cause summary: transient controller overload on rwd-gpu-alloc-12 that caused request backpressure and short-lived model-serving process retries; autoscaler activity restored desired capacity in ~90s but degraded tail latency for ~27 minutes overall.
- Autoscaler trigger reason: surge in incoming tokenization workload leading to temporary GPU queueing; not a hardware failure or controller restart.

Next steps on remedies and timing:
1) We'll run the contractual eligibility calc (per your Enterprise SLA) and return a formal service-credit proposal within 48 business hours (by Mon, 26 Jul EOD PDT). The calc will include total outage minutes and prorated credit.
2) RCA write-up: Monica will draft a short RCA (1–2 pages) and include mitigation actions and permanent guardrails; draft by Mon, 26 Jul.
3) Post-incident review: propose Tue, 27 Jul at 10:00 AM PDT for a 30-minute sync.

If you need an accelerated window for the compensation proposal, let me know and we'll prioritize. We apologize for the disruption and will include detailed telemetry in SUP-4582.

-David
